## findPolicyPath() function

Find policy file in standard locations.

Searches for policy configuration in the following order: 1. .attest-it/policy.yaml 2. .attest-it/policy.yml 3. .attest-it/policy.json

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function findPolicyPath(startDir?: string): null | string;
```
